name: Starship
subtitle: Dodge fire and defeat the flagship
description: Pilot a ship through three waves and a flagship encounter. Steer with taps or swipes, dodge enemy bolts, and line up your automatic shots. Play offline with saved progress and a best score.

versions.notes:
Added real-time steering, automatic fire, moving fleets, and traveling projectiles with collisions.
Added four arcade waves, including a flagship encounter, with a brief break between waves.
Pause flight when the Kindle sleeps or returns from USB drive mode. Save and resume the mission and best score from a separate arcade save.
Pilot a ship through three short waves and a flagship encounter. Read the next volley, dodge between lanes, and time your shots and shields. Play offline with saved progress and a best score.
